ui.此局八关，皆在此天时之下。: All eight stages fall under this omen.
ui.汉军溃于垓下，刘邦北走。霸王定鼎彭城，楚旗蔽野，天下再入楚制。: The Han army broke at Gaixia and Liu Bang fled north. The Hegemon-King enthroned his court at Pengcheng — Chu banners shadow the land, and the realm returns to Chu rule.
